scenario: a misunderstanding or problem involving public transport
english_title: Recognising and Responding to a Misunderstanding or Problem Involving Public Transport
vietnamese_title: Giao tiếp nền tảng: public transport — a misunderstanding or problem involving public transport
primary_communication_goal: recognise and respond to a misunderstanding or problem involving public transport; complete the exchange naturally at A0 / Pre-A1.
context_note_en: Ms Lan asks Ms Sarah if her stop is already behind them.
context_note_vi: Chị Lan hỏi chị Sarah trạm dừng của mình đã qua chưa.

turns.speaker: Ms Lan
turns.english: Excuse me, Sarah. Is my stop already behind us?
turns.vietnamese: Xin lỗi chị Sarah. Trạm của tôi qua rồi à?

turns.speaker: Ms Lan
turns.english: Oh no, what should I do?
turns.vietnamese: Ôi không, tôi phải làm sao đây?

turns.speaker: Ms Sarah
turns.english: Get off at the next stop and walk back.
turns.vietnamese: Chị xuống trạm kế tiếp rồi đi bộ lại nhé.
